definitions.short: Rapha or Raphah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H7498. Rapha ' I. רָפָא proper name, masculine in Benjamin , 1Chr 8:2 , Ραφη[α]. — II. רָפָא see רפה . — See also ר ׳בֵּית p. 112. I. רָפָה proper name, masculine in Saul's line 1Chr 8:37 , Ραφαι ( α ) , ᵐ5 L Αραχα ; see רְפָיָה . — II. ׳ר see רפה . II. רָפָה , II. רָפָא as proper name, masculine , always with article H¹-R¹ph¹ (perhaps derived from proper name, of a people II. רְפָאִים , q. v.); — הָֽרפָה 2Sam 21:16 , 18 , with preposition ׳לְהָ 21:20 . 22 = לְהָרָפָא 1Chr 20:6 , 8 ; — only as parent, הָר ׳בִּילִידֵי 2Sam 21:16 , 18 (= הָֽרְפָאִים מִילִירֵי 1Chr 20:4 ); לְהָר ׳יֻלַּד 1 Chronicles 20:20. 22 || 20:6 , 8 . — I. רָפָה see below רפָא .

occurrences.englishText: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
